items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: This is my granddaughter from California. This is Joycelyn.

ctx.x: I'll just put them all. I'll save them all. Now there. Oh, wait. Now this is the thing I have to get at. They want to see this picture. Now the first children. This was the first children who rode in our first parade. Now this is the little girl who's going to be queen next year. Right here. So she was made this year. Cynthia. Cynthia Paul. And they're all children between eight and ten. Six, seven, and ten. This little girl lives back there. You should see how big she is. All there, all over here. And you know…
